stem: Deena would like to add some details to strengthen her third paragraph (sentences 9-10). Which of the following can BEST be added after sentence 10 to accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: Maggie learned how to light the lamp, trim the wick, and fetch the oil needed in order to keep the light burning all night long.

options.label: B
options.text: His job was exciting and adventurous, and there were many interesting things for Maggie to learn while she was there.

options.label: C
options.text: In that day and age, there was no one else to assist Captain Frank with the job that he had loved so much for so long.

options.label: D
options.text: Being a lighthouse keeper was hard work, and although Maggie wasn’t all that interested, she listened anyway.
